paragraphs: He asks Rav Huna a question in Eruvin 67b. Hyman reports that Yuchasin reads Rabbah bar Chakula, and so does Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Eruvin 67b fully writes Rav Huna, supporting that expansion of ר״ה. Hyman’s separate Chaklai/Chakula and Rava/Rabbah variants remain distinct.

The whole Davidson Eruvin 67b paragraph has Rava bar Chaklai asking Rav Huna, supporting that local expansion of ר״ה. The Yuchasin and Dikdukei Soferim readings remain Hyman’s reports, without fresh collation of those works. Rava/Rabbah and Chaklai/Chakula are retained separately.
